body: Was a Senior Mod here for a while, also bored rn, AMA.

title: Nolan's AMA?

replies.author: Joao_Victor
replies.body:
Burnt myself out on Minecraft in general for the 9 months I was staff.

I enjoyed moderating very much, I loved helping the community and saw it as a gift rather than a burden, and I made plenty of new friends on the staff team, and they respected me for the hard work I put into Avicus.

But by January I had burnt myself out, so I called it quits.
